selection: All geometrically full-box dual-polarization IW RTC candidates. Deduplicate same-platform absolute-orbit passes; keep platform, relative orbit and direction separate. No selection by radar return.
gap_comparison: For each withheld optical acquisition, report latest radar catalog acquisition at or before that optical timestamp within each track; never use future radar scenes.
scope: Catalog and anonymous-access feasibility only. No backscatter extraction, fusion, crop condition, soil moisture or model claim. A seven-day catalog match is not measured usable coverage.
